Home: start here. Import a supported file from your device and inspect its decoded result.
Decode text: paste an encoded link or protocol directly from Home. Copy or export the full decoded result.
History: reopen previous results, find a configuration, mark favorites or delete records.
Formats: explore the supported file extensions and search for an app or format.
Settings: choose the language, control privacy, manage history and contact Ghost Developer through Telegram.

HTTP Injector Cloud (online): on Home, open Cloud, paste an ehi.link URL, cloud key or 💉…🚀 emoji code, then tap Import. This sends the reference to the HTTP Injector server only after you tap; Internet is required. Local files and texts stay offline.

Protected HTTP Custom (.hc): import the file as usual. If the file requests an export password, HWID (32 characters) or both, enter exactly the required credentials. Wrong values or tampered files cannot be decrypted; ordinary .hc files still use the original method.
